headline: CATL launches the largest cancellation-style buyback in A-share history; first 200 million yuan already in; buyback cap 40 billion yuan
summary: CATL has started what is described as the largest cancellation-style buyback in A-share history, with the first 200 million yuan already in and a cap of 40 billion yuan. Its global power battery share was 40.2% in January to May 2026.
why: CATL, based in Ningde, Fujian, is the world's largest maker of electric vehicle batteries, so its capital returns and market share matter to battery and EV supply chains.

impacts.name: CATL
impacts.why: A large share buyback with a 40 billion yuan cap reduces share count and signals management confidence.
